description: Na₂MgInF₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.90 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent InF₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent InF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-63°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.59 Å. Mg is bonded to six F atoms to form MgF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgF₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent InF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-56°. There are a spread of Mg-F bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.04 Å. In is bonded to six F atoms to form InF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-56°. There are three shorter (2.11 Å) and three longer (2.13 Å) In-F bond lengths. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one In atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃In tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one In atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃In tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Mg atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one In atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one In atom.
